units.source_text: [2] 京都平安神宫从1895年开始，每年10月22日举行的游神节，

en.t: [2] At Kyoto's Heian Shrine, the Jidai Matsuri festival has been held every year on October 22 since 1895,

units.source_text: 展示自平安时代至明治维新各个时期的风俗变迁。

en.t: showing the changes in customs and manners from the Heian period through the Meiji Restoration.
